classification.difficultyReason: Calculate daily wages and compare them with a supplied daily payment.

content.prompt:
Alyssa is paid \$36.90 per hour and works an 8-hour day. Connor earns \$320 per day.
Who earns more per day and by how much?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Alyssa's daily pay}&=\$36.90\times8\\\text{Alyssa's daily pay}&=\$295.20\\\text{Difference}&=\$320-\$295.20\\\text{Difference}&=\$24.80\end{align*}$$
Connor earns \$24.80 more per day.
